title: Equation of Foreign Qualifications
description: Draft public-service guidance; review questions must be resolved before publication.
clarifying_questions: Which qualification, awarding country and intended purpose does your question concern?

claims.text: KNEC evaluates school and post-school qualifications under specified eligibility conditions; institutional-based certificates are excluded by this guideline.
The awarding body must send authentication directly to KNEC before processing begins. Certificates outside English/Kiswahili require an accepted translation.
Upload a request explaining purpose and destination, qualification evidence and identity documentation through QMIS. Ordinary/Advanced Level applicants also provide primary-level evidence.
Where equation criteria do not exist, further syllabus, assessment, sample-paper, grading and certificate evidence is required.
The equation letter is restricted to its addressed institution; it is not for copying or redirecting to the applicant or another institution.
The guideline lists KES 3,480 per letter including registered mail, with an additional KES 928 for email dispatch.
The awarding board must be accredited, or the institution legally authorized to examine and issue certificates. Applicants must meet the corresponding KNEC course entry requirements.

Advanced Level applicants submit both Ordinary and Advanced Level certificates, authenticated directly by the awarding institution. The guideline requires at least Division II at Ordinary Level or KCSE mean grade C (Plain).
For equation to KCSE, the 2025 guideline specifies at least seven subjects including Mathematics, a language and five other subjects. This is one eligibility condition, not a guarantee of equation.
The applicant must have completed the required study years or contact hours at the relevant level.
For certificates outside English or Kiswahili, the guideline names the relevant Embassy, Alliance Francaise for French, or another recognized institution for other languages as translation providers.
The issuing examination body sends verification directly to the KNEC Chief Executive Officer at ceo@knec.ac.ke. Processing begins only after that confirmation is received.

The request includes purpose, recipient institution postal address and applicant contact details. For primary qualifications, the institution head also states entry year, entry level and current level; learners joining CBC provide the last two years of progress reports.

The guideline requires M-Pesa payment following the system-generated prompt in the applicant QMIS status. It states that other payment methods are invalid and manual applications or bank deposit slips are not accepted.
The guideline lists ceo@knec.ac.ke, equation@knec.ac.ke and archives@knec.ac.ke for further enquiries.

unresolved_questions: Resolve timeline start: guideline p2 section6 uses receipt of payment; charter p4 row14 uses complete accurate documentation.
Confirm qualification-specific eligibility with an authorized reviewer; the assistant must not decide equivalence.
Confirm present portal behavior, later amendments and named content approval.
